slug: 2025-01-01 South African Digital Sovereignty at the Crossroad of Securitization and Development (Chapter 4) - Digital Sovereignty in the BRICS Countries
note: Only the Draft National Policy on Data and Cloud (published 2021-04-01) is discussed, a cloud and data localisation policy of class other; no national data policy as the study defines it.

facts.fact: The Department of Communications and Digital Technologies issued the final National Policy on Data and Cloud as Notice 2533 of 2024 in Government Gazette 50741 of 31 May 2024, setting government policy on the collection, storage, use and sharing of data across national and provincial government, organs of state and the private sector; the notice carries no printed day, so the date is the gazette date.
facts.system: National Policy on Data and Cloud

facts.fact: The policy names the State Information Technology Agency (SITA) as the responsible authority to source data infrastructure and cloud services for government, to develop and monitor service level agreements, to monitor access to government data under the Minimum Information Security Standards, and to drive the e-Strategy; the document's governance section (15.8) is not in the text held, and it names no issued rule.
facts.system: National Policy on Data and Cloud

facts.fact: The Minister for Public Service and Administration signed the Determination and Directive on the Implementation of Data Governance in the Public Service, with the Public Service Data Governance Framework as Annexure A, in effect on signature and repealing the 14 February 2024 knowledge and data management directive.
facts.system: Determination and Directive on the Implementation of Data Governance in the Public Service

facts.fact: The directive requires each Head of Department to establish a Data Governance Committee and a Data Governance Office and to appoint a Chief Data Officer (which may be filled within 24 months).
